name.title: Name
name.description: Plugin name as shown in the logs

pollingRate.title: Polling Rate (in milliseconds)
pollingRate.description: The polling rate for light status in milliseconds (minimum 250)

powerOnBehavior.title: Power On Behaviour
powerOnBehavior.description: What the lights do when switched on: their last settings, or the default brightness and colour temperature below. Empty keeps the light's own setting.

powerOnBrightness.title: Default Power On Brightness (in percent)
powerOnBrightness.description: The brightness the lights switch on at with Restore default settings

powerOnTemperature.title: Default Power On Colour Temperature (in Kelvin)
powerOnTemperature.description: The colour temperature the lights switch on at with Restore default settings

switchOnDurationMs.title: Switch On Duration (in milliseconds)
switchOnDurationMs.description: How long the lights take to fade in when switched on

switchOffDurationMs.title: Switch Off Duration (in milliseconds)
switchOffDurationMs.description: How long the lights take to fade out when switched off

colorChangeDurationMs.title: Colour Change Duration (in milliseconds)
colorChangeDurationMs.description: How long the lights take to move to a new colour temperature

useIP.title: Use IP address instead of hostname
useIP.description: By default, the hostname of the light is used for the connection. If this causes issues in your environment, you can enable this option to use the IP address instead.

addresses.title: Lights by address
addresses.description: Lights Bonjour does not reach, for example from a container without multicast or on another network. Every light Bonjour finds is added without an entry here.

host.title: IP address or host name
host.description: Where the light answers, for example 192.168.1.50.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port of the light's HTTP API, 9123 by default.

mac.title: MAC Address
mac.description: The light's MAC address, which Homeswift keys lights by. Empty, Homeswift asks the light for it.

powerOnBehavior.title: Power On Behaviour
powerOnBehavior.description: What this light does when switched on. Empty takes the plugin's setting.

powerOnBrightness.title: Default Brightness (%)
powerOnBrightness.description: This light's brightness with Restore default settings. Empty takes the plugin's setting.

powerOnTemperature.title: Default Temperature (K)
powerOnTemperature.description: This light's colour temperature with Restore default settings, 2900 to 7000. Empty takes the plugin's setting; 0 keeps the light's own.

fr.By default, the hostname of the light is: Par défaut, la connexion utilise le nom d'hôte de la lampe. Si cela pose problème dans votre environnement, activez cette option pour utiliser plutôt l'adresse IP.
fr.Colour Change Duration (in milliseconds): Durée du changement de couleur (en millisecondes)
fr.Default Power On Brightness (in percent): Luminosité à l'allumage par défaut (en pourcentage)
fr.Default Power On Colour Temperature (in: Température de couleur à l'allumage par défaut (en kelvins)
fr.How long the lights take to fade in when: Le temps que mettent les lampes à s'allumer progressivement
fr.How long the lights take to fade out whe: Le temps que mettent les lampes à s'éteindre progressivement
fr.How long the lights take to move to a ne: Le temps que mettent les lampes pour passer à une nouvelle température de couleur
fr.Lights Bonjour does not reach, for examp: Les lampes que Bonjour ne joint pas, par exemple depuis un conteneur sans multicast ou sur un autre réseau. Toutes les lampes que Bonjour trouve sont ajoutées sans entrée ici.
fr.Name: Nom
fr.Plugin name as shown in the logs: Nom du plugin tel qu'affiché dans les journaux
fr.The brightness the lights switch on at w: La luminosité à laquelle les lampes s'allument avec Rétablir les réglages par défaut
fr.The colour temperature the lights switch: La température de couleur à laquelle les lampes s'allument avec Rétablir les réglages par défaut
fr.The light's MAC address, which Homeswift: L'adresse MAC de la lampe, qui sert de clé à Homeswift. Vide, Homeswift la demande à la lampe.
fr.The polling rate for light status in mil: La fréquence d'interrogation de l'état des lampes en millisecondes (250 minimum)
fr.The port of the light's HTTP API, 9123 b: Le port de l'API HTTP de la lampe, 9123 par défaut.
fr.This light's brightness with Restore def: La luminosité de cette lampe avec Rétablir les réglages par défaut. Vide prend le réglage du plugin.
fr.This light's colour temperature with Res: La température de couleur de cette lampe avec Rétablir les réglages par défaut, de 2900 à 7000. Vide prend le réglage du plugin ; 0 garde celle de la lampe.
fr.Use IP address instead of hostname: Utiliser l'adresse IP au lieu du nom d'hôte
fr.What the lights do when switched on: the: Ce que font les lampes à l'allumage : reprendre leurs derniers réglages, ou la luminosité et la température de couleur par défaut ci-dessous. Vide garde le réglage de la lampe.
fr.What this light does when switched on. E: Ce que fait cette lampe à l'allumage. Vide prend le réglage du plugin.
fr.Where the light answers, for example 192: Là où la lampe répond, par exemple 192.168.1.50.

es.By default, the hostname of the light is: Por defecto, la conexión usa el nombre de host de la luz. Si eso da problemas en tu entorno, activa esta opción para usar la dirección IP.
es.Colour Change Duration (in milliseconds): Duración del cambio de color (en milisegundos)
es.Default Power On Colour Temperature (in: Temperatura de color al encender predeterminada (en kelvin)
es.How long the lights take to fade in when: Lo que tardan las luces en encenderse gradualmente
es.How long the lights take to fade out whe: Lo que tardan las luces en apagarse gradualmente
es.How long the lights take to move to a ne: Lo que tardan las luces en pasar a una nueva temperatura de color
es.IP address or host name: Dirección IP o nombre de host
es.Lights Bonjour does not reach, for examp: Las luces que Bonjour no alcanza, por ejemplo desde un contenedor sin multicast o en otra red. Todas las luces que Bonjour encuentra se añaden sin entrada aquí.
es.Name: Nombre
es.Plugin name as shown in the logs: Nombre del plugin tal como aparece en los registros
es.The brightness the lights switch on at w: El brillo con el que se encienden las luces con Restaurar los ajustes predeterminados
es.The colour temperature the lights switch: La temperatura de color con la que se encienden las luces con Restaurar los ajustes predeterminados
es.The light's MAC address, which Homeswift: La dirección MAC de la luz, con la que Homeswift identifica las luces. Vacía, Homeswift se la pide a la luz.
es.The polling rate for light status in mil: La frecuencia de consulta del estado de las luces en milisegundos (250 como mínimo)
es.The port of the light's HTTP API, 9123 b: El puerto de la API HTTP de la luz, 9123 por defecto.
es.This light's brightness with Restore def: El brillo de esta luz con Restaurar los ajustes predeterminados. Vacío toma el ajuste del plugin.
es.This light's colour temperature with Res: La temperatura de color de esta luz con Restaurar los ajustes predeterminados, de 2900 a 7000. Vacío toma el ajuste del plugin; 0 conserva la de la luz.
es.Use IP address instead of hostname: Usar la dirección IP en lugar del nombre de host
es.What the lights do when switched on: the: Lo que hacen las luces al encenderse: sus últimos ajustes, o el brillo y la temperatura de color predeterminados de abajo. Vacío conserva el ajuste de la luz.
es.What this light does when switched on. E: Lo que hace esta luz al encenderse. Vacío toma el ajuste del plugin.
es.Where the light answers, for example 192: Donde responde la luz, por ejemplo 192.168.1.50.

pt.By default, the hostname of the light is: Por predefinição, a ligação usa o nome de anfitrião da luz. Se isso causar problemas no seu ambiente, ative esta opção para usar o endereço IP.
pt.Colour Change Duration (in milliseconds): Duração da mudança de cor (em milissegundos)
pt.Default Power On Colour Temperature (in: Temperatura de cor ao ligar predefinida (em kelvin)
pt.How long the lights take to fade in when: O tempo que as luzes demoram a acender gradualmente
pt.How long the lights take to fade out whe: O tempo que as luzes demoram a apagar gradualmente
pt.How long the lights take to move to a ne: O tempo que as luzes demoram a passar para uma nova temperatura de cor
pt.IP address or host name: Endereço IP ou nome de anfitrião
pt.Lights Bonjour does not reach, for examp: As luzes que o Bonjour não alcança, por exemplo a partir de um contentor sem multicast ou noutra rede. Todas as luzes que o Bonjour encontra são adicionadas sem entrada aqui.
pt.Name: Nome
pt.Plugin name as shown in the logs: Nome do plugin tal como aparece nos registos
pt.The brightness the lights switch on at w: O brilho com que as luzes acendem com Repor as definições predefinidas
pt.The colour temperature the lights switch: A temperatura de cor com que as luzes acendem com Repor as definições predefinidas
pt.The light's MAC address, which Homeswift: O endereço MAC da luz, pelo qual o Homeswift identifica as luzes. Vazio, o Homeswift pede-o à luz.
pt.The polling rate for light status in mil: A frequência de consulta do estado das luzes em milissegundos (250 no mínimo)
pt.The port of the light's HTTP API, 9123 b: A porta da API HTTP da luz, 9123 por predefinição.
pt.This light's brightness with Restore def: O brilho desta luz com Repor as definições predefinidas. Vazio usa a definição do plugin.
pt.This light's colour temperature with Res: A temperatura de cor desta luz com Repor as definições predefinidas, de 2900 a 7000. Vazio usa a definição do plugin; 0 mantém a da luz.
pt.Use IP address instead of hostname: Usar o endereço IP em vez do nome de anfitrião
pt.What the lights do when switched on: the: O que as luzes fazem ao ligar: as últimas definições, ou o brilho e a temperatura de cor predefinidos abaixo. Vazio mantém a definição da luz.
pt.What this light does when switched on. E: O que esta luz faz ao ligar. Vazio usa a definição do plugin.
pt.Where the light answers, for example 192: Onde a luz responde, por exemplo 192.168.1.50.
